title: RistHome creative experiment row (data/experiments.csv)
description: One row per published variant. Identity and hypothesis columns are filled at render time by hand; metric columns stay empty until read from Instagram Insights, GA4 or the CRM. Never estimate a metric.

variant_id.description: A, B, C... within the experiment

success_metric.description: Formula over the metric columns, decided before publishing

link_clicks.source: Instagram Insights > External link taps, or GA4 sessions with utm_content=<post_slug>

inquiries.source: WhatsApp + site form messages that mention the post or arrive within 72 h of publishing

qualified_inquiries.description: Inquiries with date, guests and place

bookings.source: CRM (~/LAVORO/RISTHOME/RistHome_CRM_2026.xlsx) rows attributed to the post

contribution_margin_eur.description: revenue minus direct costs (ingredients, assistants, commissions); 60% of revenue is the working assumption until measured
